findings.motion: House roll call #801, motion M11 Concur in the Senate committee substitute for HB 958, Election Law Changes (passed 62-47). K. Brown is listed among the Noes.
findings.note: She voted no on concurring with the Senate version of HB 958, which the House passed 62-47. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H958v9.html) requires county boards to process a voter registration application only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a citizen, with a 30-day sworn-statement notice when the citizenship question is left blank; adds the same citizenship question check at motor vehicle offices; allows data-sharing with other states to cross-check voter records; and sends monthly motor vehicle data to the State Board for list maintenance. Per the bill page the Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (roll call 758)
findings.note: HB 958 (Election Law Changes) is an omnibus election bill. The edition read here includes voter-list maintenance, removal of voters flagged as possible non-citizens, and absentee and ballot-challenge changes. The roll call transcript lists this member among the Noes.

findings.motion: HB 1246 Safeguarding Elections Act, co-sponsor (not primary sponsor)
findings.note: Her legislature bills list shows HB 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act, referred to committee on 2026-08-04 with her as a non-primary sponsor. The bill text (draft version 0) makes it a misdemeanor to demand citizenship documentation from a voter beyond what State law requires, and adds rules on poll observers and ballot challenges.
